papers.headline: Rest-frame annihilation lines of ∼70 GeV WIMPs in 23,000 stacked galaxy clusters
papers.summary: Weakly interacting massive particle (WIMP) annihilation features were reported as a 43 GeV line in three Fermi-LAT galaxy clusters (mathttS₃), as triad γγ, γZ,γh lines from ∼70 GeV WIMPs in LAT data cross-correlated (mathttC_mathttW) with western eROSITA…
papers.title: Rest-frame annihilation lines of ∼70 GeV WIMPs in 23,000 stacked galaxy clusters

papers.headline: Compositions of Exoplanetary Debris Shaped by Milky Way Stellar Abundance Patterns
papers.summary: Galactic chemical evolution (GCE) predicts large-scale variations in exoplanet compositions with host star elemental abundances, reflecting the Milky Way's history of star formation and elemental enrichment from stellar feedback.
papers.title: Compositions of Exoplanetary Debris Shaped by Milky Way Stellar Abundance Patterns

papers.headline: Gravitational Waves from Population III Black Hole Mergers in Primordial Gas Disks: Constraining Astrophysical Scenarios with the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna and the Einstein Telescope
papers.summary: The first generation of metal-free Population III (Pop III) stars provides a possible formation channel for the black hole (BH) seeds in the early Universe.
papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Population III Black Hole Mergers in Primordial Gas Disks: Constraining Astrophysical Scenarios with the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna and the Einstein Telescope
